pages.quiz:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is an advertisement? (1 mark)
   A. A weather report
   B. A lesson
   C. A poem
   D. A message that tells about a product or service to attract buyers

2. What is a personal experience? (1 mark)
   A. A rule
   B. Something that happened to you
   C. A story from a book
   D. A number

3. Which question should you ask about an advert? (1 mark)
   A. What is the paper colour?
   B. Who cut it?
   C. How many pages does it have?
   D. What is being sold and how much does it cost?

4. Which of these must always begin with a capital letter in English? (1 mark)
   A. The names of foods
   B. The names of colours
   C. The names of people
   D. The names of weather

5. Which game teaches that messages can change when passed on? (1 mark)
   A. Football
   B. Chinese whisper
   C. Skipping
   D. Hide and seek only

6. What is a good first step when skimming? (1 mark)
   A. Close the book
   B. Read the title and headings
   C. Read every word carefully
   D. Skip the page

7. What should you do if a classmate's story is not as good as yours? (1 mark)
   A. Interrupt
   B. Listen politely and give kind feedback
   C. Leave
   D. Laugh at them

8. In The seller counts the money, what is the predicate? (1 mark)
   A. The seller
   B. The
   C. money only
   D. counts the money

9. Which strategy would you use to find a price in an advert? (1 mark)
   A. Drawing
   B. Scanning
   C. Skimming
   D. Singing

10. Which interjection shows surprise? (1 mark)
   A. Yuck
   B. Shh
   C. Wow
   D. Ouch

11. What should you do while listening to instructions about where to place objects? (1 mark)
   A. Listen to the whole instruction before acting
   B. Move immediately
   C. Talk
   D. Look away

12. Why record yourself reciting? (1 mark)
   A. To delete your voice
   B. To lose the poem
   C. To stop practising
   D. To listen back and improve

13. What is the first thing to do when someone gets a burn? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore it
   B. Rub it hard
   C. Cover it with dirt
   D. Put the burn under cool running water

14. Which is a part of a form? (1 mark)
   A. Riddle
   B. Ending song
   C. Title
   D. Poem

15. Why are interjections used more in speech than in formal writing? (1 mark)
   A. They are difficult
   B. They are long
   C. They are illegal in writing
   D. They show quick feelings in speech

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain what attentive listening means. (2 marks)

17. Put in order: shillings the pays customer fifty (3 marks)

18. Read: Millet porridge is a warm drink made by mixing millet flour with water and boiling it. What is it made from and how is it cooked? (3 marks)

19. Explain why sequencing ideas is important in writing. (3 marks)

20. Explain what a dialogue is. (2 marks)

21. Give two rules for looking after class library books. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — A message that tells about a product or service to attract buyers
   Adverts promote products or services.

2. B — Something that happened to you
   A personal experience is an event you lived.

3. D — What is being sold and how much does it cost?
   Buyers check product and price.

4. C — The names of people
   Names of people and places begin with capital letters.

5. B — Chinese whisper
   In Chinese whisper the message changes as it passes.

6. B — Read the title and headings
   The title tells the topic.

7. B — Listen politely and give kind feedback
   Respect is important.

8. D — counts the money
   The predicate tells what the subject does.

9. B — Scanning
   You know exactly what you need.

10. C — Wow
   Wow is used for surprise.

11. A — Listen to the whole instruction before acting
   Full listening avoids mistakes.

12. D — To listen back and improve
   Playback shows how to improve.

13. D — Put the burn under cool running water
   Cool water reduces pain and damage.

14. C — Title
   A form has a title.

15. D — They show quick feelings in speech
   Formal writing usually uses full sentences.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Attentive listening means choosing to give your eyes, ears and mind to the speaker so that you understand and remember what is said.
   Working / marking points: One mark for choosing to pay attention and one mark for understanding or remembering.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: The customer pays fifty shillings.
   Working / marking points: One mark for the words in order, one for the capital and one for the full stop.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is made from millet flour and water and it is cooked by boiling.
   Working / marking points: One mark for millet flour, one for water, one for boiling.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: It helps the reader follow the ideas, avoids confusion and makes writing logical.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each valid point.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A dialogue is a conversation between two or more people, shown with each speaker's name and words.
   Working / marking points: One mark for conversation and one for speakers.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Turn pages gently, never write in them, return them on time, keep them clean (any two).
   Working / marking points: One mark for each rule.
